csv_encoding.numbers: JSON round-trip representation, no decimal rounding
csv_encoding.field_paths: original JSON dotted paths; traceback omitted only

provenance.basis: Recorded checkpoint, original model source, puzzle and input hashes match prior JSON; dataset assets are not rehashed by this transformation.

context.input_method: unchanged v1 legal stratified random walks; iid categorical stress
context.limitation: walk length is not true distance; no recorded frontiers; active device count1

protocol.acceptance: finite elementwise exact original monolithic Q on both corpora; not full beam/replay
protocol.weights: runtime FP32 original and runtime BF16 typed/candidates; captured named separately
protocol.selection: minimize Q; parent-major/move-minor; stable score/flat-id topK proxy
protocol.timing: already compiled device-resident synchronized calls; alternating forward/reverse ordering
protocol.queued: same executable with retained outputs, not real 128-chunk scan
protocol.profiles: diagnostic, independent of correctness; unsuccessful compile has no runtime timing

promotion_decision.reason: only exact non-control candidates on all16K corpora qualify;32K confirmation separate

cautions: Raw q.eligible means finite only; acceptance requires finite elementwise-exact original Q on both corpora.
No non-control full candidate qualified; no eligible speedup or 32K measurement is reported.
Original-runtime baseline has no recorded self-comparison; empty metric cells are intentional.
Matching aggregate errors do not establish pairwise tensor equality or a causal mechanism.
Full candidates retain JAX embedding/input/head; this is not an all-Pallas model.
Stable minimizing global topK diagnostics do not establish distributed-beam or replay validity.
Inverse masking is diagnostic only; stress last_move=-1 makes its mask all-valid.
Queued calls reuse the same executable; they are neither one-call latency nor a real chunk scan.
Profiles and timings remain diagnostics when the exact-Q gate fails.
